title: Reviewed Snapshot (v1)
description: Human-reviewed snapshot of a pool schedule extraction. Locks a canonical payload to a specific PDF content hash.

slug.description: Pool slug. Must match the containing directory name.

pdf_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source PDF bytes. Locks this snapshot to that exact document.

reviewed_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) in Pacific time when the reviewer approved this payload.

source_pdf_url.description: Canonical URL the PDF was fetched from at review time.

schedule_effective.description: Start of the window this schedule is valid for.

schedule_effective_end.description: Optional end date of the schedule window. Null or omitted if open-ended.

sessions.description: Weekly swim sessions. validate() rejects payloads with fewer than 5; schema only enforces shape.

type.description: Session category. Add new values here first, then teach the template.

end.description: 24-hour end time, HH:MM. Must be strictly greater than start.

pool.description: Optional sub-pool identifier for multi-pool venues (e.g. 'deep', 'shallow').

evidence.description: Optional verbatim PDF line this session came from. Stripped on canonicalization.

notes.description: Optional reviewer note. Stripped on canonicalization.

end.description: Must be ≥ start. Single-day closures use start == end.
